In 2023, the City of Syracuse embarked on a transformation of solid waste collection investing in
neighborhoods, residents, and city employees. The program involved giving residents uniform covered
trash carts on wheels, each holding 96 gallons. This initiative yielded cleaner neighborhoods, no cart
related injuries that required treatment, and approximately $150,000 saved on disposal fees since the
beginning of the cart program.

COVERED RECYCLING CARTS WITH WHEELS
Similar to the trash cart program, we are currently planning a program to supply residents with new
recycling carts. They will also have covers and wheels. This initiative comes as OCRRA discontinues its
blue bin program throughout Onondaga County. While these blue bins have been utilized across the
county for three decades, their open design has significantly contributed to litter problems in
neighborhoods. The goal of the program is to provide residents with convenient, easy to use recycling
carts while meeting industry standards and best practices. These changes aim to improve services,
reduce costs, and ensure worker safety.
